steps.name: Verify source, dependency, and license gates
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p .release/internal-ci/$CI_COMMIT_SHA/gates; npm run audit:prod; test -x ./node_modules/.bin/license-checker; ./node_modules/.bin/license-checker --failOn 'GPL-2.0;GPL-3.0'; npm run lint; npm run typecheck; npm run test:migration; node scripts/verify-observability-configs.mjs --root . --tool-mode container; node scripts/record-internal-ci-gate.mjs source-validation .release/internal-ci/$CI_COMMIT_SHA/gates/source-validation.json; node scripts/record-internal-ci-gate.mjs dependency-license .release/internal-ci/$CI_COMMIT_SHA/gates/dependency-license.json

steps.name: Run active local Semgrep SAST
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p .release/internal-ci/$CI_COMMIT_SHA/semgrep; docker run --rm --user $(id -u):$(id -g) --env HOME=/tmp/semgrep-home --volume $PWD:/src --workdir /src semgrep/semgrep:1.169.0@sha256:2b33f46ba66cf8cc2ad59ccfa7d22951fd00c632c38f1339e84ec8e6e641a942 semgrep scan --config p/default --error --sarif --output .release/internal-ci/$CI_COMMIT_SHA/semgrep/semgrep.sarif .; test -s .release/internal-ci/$CI_COMMIT_SHA/semgrep/semgrep.sarif; node scripts/record-internal-ci-gate.mjs sast .release/internal-ci/$CI_COMMIT_SHA/gates/sast.json

steps.name: Run JavaScript and Python unit suites
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; npx playwright install chromium; npx turbo run test -- --coverage; python3 -m venv .ci-venv; .ci-venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip; .ci-venv/bin/pip install -r apps/engine/requirements.txt -r apps/worker/requirements.txt; (cd apps/engine && ../../.ci-venv/bin/python -m pytest --cov=src --cov-fail-under=90); (cd apps/worker && ../../.ci-venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests); npm run build

steps.name: Run disposable database-backed integration suite
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; bash scripts/run-internal-ci-integration.sh; node scripts/record-internal-ci-gate.mjs integration .release/internal-ci/$CI_COMMIT_SHA/gates/integration.json
